decks.notes: This Boros Aggro deck focuses on utilizing cheap creatures with aggressive abilities to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes cards that provide additional value, such as card draw, token generation, and removal. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion allows for additional mana fixing and synergy with the rest of the deck. Overall, the key concept of the deck is to apply constant pressure on the opponent while maintaining card advantage and flexibility through different combat tricks and abilities.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly establish a board presence with aggressive creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester, Cauldron Familiar, and Mayhem Devil, while utilizing sacrifice synergies with cards like Witch's Oven and Deadly Dispute to control the board and generate value. Ygra, Eater of All acts as a powerful finisher, backed up by disruption tools like Fatal Push and Claim the Firstborn. The mana base is designed to support the aggressive strategy, with a mix of dual lands and utility lands to ensure consistent casting of spells and abilities.

The deck focuses on aggressive plays with a mix of creatures, removal, and disruption to quickly pressure the opponent and control the board. By utilizing efficient creatures like Graveyard Trespasser and Bloodtithe Harvester, along with powerful spells like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they can establish their own game plan. With a strong mana base and a variety of threats, the deck can adapt to different matchups and maintain pressure throughout the game.

This deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and fast-paced gameplay. It focuses on quickly dealing damage to the opponent's life total and winning the game before the opponent has a chance to stabilize. The key strategy is to continuously play low-cost creatures and pump spells to maximize damage output each turn. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds consistency and allows for additional mana ramp. Overall, the main goal of this deck is to be fast and relentless in its assault on the opponent.

This deck focuses on utilizing various food tokens, sacrificing creatures, and removal spells to control the board and pressure the opponent with aggressive threats. The key strategy is to generate value through sacrificing creatures with Witch's Oven and Cauldron Familiar, while also having the ability to draw cards and deal with threats efficiently. By leveraging these interactions and a versatile mana base, the deck aims to outpace and outvalue opponents in a proactive and disruptive manner.

This deck focuses on utilizing the Sacrifice mechanic to generate value and pressure the opponent with efficient threats. By sacrificing creatures like Cauldron Familiar and Ygra, Eater of All with Witch's Oven and Deadly Dispute, the deck can trigger abilities like Mayhem Devil and Bloodtithe Harvester multiple times. The deck also includes removal spells like Fatal Push and Claim the Firstborn to control the board, while Scavenger's Talent provides additional value. Jegantha, the Wellspring serves as a powerful Companion option to further enhance the deck's capabilities.

This deck focuses on creating a powerful board presence through a combination of creature spells and support cards. By utilizing the companion Keruga, the Macrosage, the player aims to draw extra cards and maintain card advantage while overwhelming their opponent with large creatures like Greater Tanuki and Trumpeting Carnosaur. Support cards like Spark Double and Release to the Wind help protect and duplicate key creatures, while Bedeck / Bedazzle and Leyline Binding provide versatile removal options. With a diverse mana base including various lands with unique abilities, this deck aims to control the battlefield and outvalue the opponent.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with low-cost, efficient creatures (Weenies) while utilizing cards like Thalia's Lieutenant and Brave the Elements to pump them up and protect them. The deck aims to maintain board presence and put pressure on the opponent early in the game, using cards like Adeline, Resplendent Cathar and Coppercoat Vanguard to deal damage quickly. The inclusion of removal like Giant Killer and Parting Gust helps to deal with threats from the opponent, while lands like Mutavault and Cavern of Souls provide additional utility and synergy with the deck's strategy.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize spells like Opt, Consider, and Lightning Axe to quickly cycle through the deck and play Arclight Phoenix as early as possible. Cards like Picklock Prankster and Ledger Shredder help to create additional tokens and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and efficient spells, while also generating card advantage with Treasure Cruise and Proft's Eidetic Memory. The mana base includes lands that facilitate easy access to both red and blue mana sources for casting spells efficiently.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying creatures and pressuring the opponent with efficient attacks. It emphasizes aggressive plays and uses cards like Knight-Errant of Eos, Venerated Loxodon, and Imodane's Recruiter to establish a strong board presence. Thalia, Guardian of Thraben disrupts the opponent's tempo, while Resolute Reinforcements and Warden of the Inner Sky provide additional support for the aggro strategy. The deck includes various removal spells like Gleeful Demolition to deal with threats and aims to overwhelm the opponent before they can stabilize.

The key concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy that focuses on devotion to green mana. By utilizing powerful green creatures like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll, along with mana ramp from Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves, the deck aims to quickly build a strong board presence. Storm the Festival and Invasion of Ixalan provide additional card advantage and Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner helps to untap lands for more mana acceleration. Leyline of the Guildpact boosts the devotion to green, while lands like Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and Boseiju, Who Endures provide additional mana support.

This Esper Control deck focuses on controlling the game by utilizing a variety of removal spells, counterspells, and board wipes to disrupt the opponent's plans. The deck also includes card draw and planeswalkers to generate card advantage and maintain board presence. Yorion, Sky Nomad is used as a powerful companion to provide additional value and synergize with the deck's strategy. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's color requirements and ensure consistent access to all necessary resources.

The deck focuses on assembling the Greasefang, Okiba Boss and Parhelion II combo to create a powerful win condition. By utilizing cards like Sentinel of the Nameless City and Raffine's Informant to help search for key pieces, the deck is able to quickly set up its game-winning combination. Additional cards like Esika's Chariot and Skysovereign, Consul Flagship provide support and removal options, while Thoughtseize and Duress help disrupt opponents' strategies. The deck aims to efficiently control the board and overwhelm the opponent with its powerful combo.

This Jund aggro deck focuses on sacrificing creatures for value using cards like Cauldron Familiar, Mayhem Devil, and Witch's Oven. The strategy revolves around dealing incremental damage to the opponent while generating value from sacrificing creatures. Ygra, Eater of All and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provide additional threats and synergy with the sacrifice theme. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Fatal Push and Claim the Firstborn, along with card advantage from Scavenger's Talent. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and synergy from sacrificing them.

The deck focuses on using Lotus Field and various untap effects to generate a large amount of mana quickly, allowing the player to cast powerful spells like Emergent Ultimatum and Peer into the Abyss. The deck includes cards like Hidden Strings and Vizier of Tumbling Sands to untap Lotus Field multiple times in a turn, while also including toolbox cards like Bala Ged Recovery and Boseiju, Who Endures for added flexibility and resilience. The goal is to assemble the combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with a game-winning play.

This Mono Black Control deck focuses on removal, hand disruption, and graveyard interaction. It aims to control the board with cards like Fatal Push and Sheoldred's Edict, while disrupting the opponent's hand with Thoughtseize and Go Blank. The deck also utilizes Waste Not to benefit from discarding cards and Graveyard Trespasser to disrupt the opponent's graveyard. The inclusion of Liliana of the Veil and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse provide additional control options. The mana base includes utility lands like Field of Ruin and Castle Locthwain to ensure flexibility in handling various threats.
